topic: How to write product descriptions that convert
caption:
Most ecommerce stores treat product descriptions as an afterthought, dumping manufacturer specs or dense paragraphs onto the page.

High-converting descriptions do two things well: they answer buyer doubts before they arise, and they make scanning effortless on mobile screens.

What is the biggest challenge you face when writing descriptions for your products?
